From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>

Subject: ClearLake onboarding: MAP sync, handoff bridge, and acceptance checkpoints

Hi Sam / Elena —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Per our discussion I attached a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and a draft SOW for your review (files: Redwood_MAP-v1.xlsx, SOW-draft-ClearLake.docx). This thread is to lock down the handoff mechanics and acceptance checkpoints so we can set a firm go-live window.

High-level proposal (please confirm):
- Kickoff & environment provisioning: target week of Apr 6 — Redwood to provision staging and share access.
- Integration sprint (3 weeks): customer engineering + Redwood implementation. Milestones: API connectivity (week 1), end-to-end inference test (week 2), validation & performance sign-off (week 3).
- UAT & acceptance (1 week): ClearLake runs acceptance tests against agreed prompt set; Redwood provides regression support.
- Go-live: target Apr 30 (subject to acceptance).

Suggested owners (Redwood):
- Account lead: Aditya Rao (me) — overall timeline and approvals
- Implementation lead: Monica Patel — runbook, weekly sprints, escalation
- Customer success (post-go-live): Marissa Cole — adoption, metrics
- SRE/infra contact: Ben Carter — staging capacity, performance tuning

Immediate asks for ClearLake:
1) Please confirm the procurement contact (I see procurement@clearlake.com copied on this thread) and whether PO terms will be required before kickoff.
2) Confirm whether Apr 30 as go-live target is acceptable or if you prefer to slide ~2 weeks later (we can compress integration to keep the date if you can assign a second engineer for parallel test work).
3) Any security checklist items we should pre-emptively complete prior to provisioning?

Propose a 30-minute weekly working session starting Mar 22 (Tuesdays 10am PT) — we can cancel if schedules conflict.

Thanks — attaching MAP (v1) for your notes.

—
Aditya Rao
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.com

Appreciate the clear breakdown and the MAP. Procurement here is Procurement Team <procurement@clearlake.com> (they handle POs and contract redlines). Elena (cc'd) will be our engineering lead on this engagement.

A couple of items from our side:
- Apr 30 go-live looks aggressive given internal QA calendars; can we target May 14 instead? If Redwood can prioritize the performance sign-off earlier we'll try to free up two engineers for parallel testing.
- Security: we'll send the standard vendor questionnaire this afternoon — the SOC2 attestation and network diagram will be required before provisioning.
- We like the weekly working session cadence. Tue 10am PT works for the first three weeks.
